UNITPOWEROFATTORNEY CENTRALPARKVACATIONSUITES The undersigned: MICHAELEBROADYandVIDABROADY,husbandandwife,astenantsbythe entirety having an address c/o Central Park Vacation Suites,101 West 57h Street,NewYork,NewYork 10019, is the Grantee to that certain Deed conveying an undivided tenant-in-common interest in the Condominium Unit known as Unit5, otherwise known as CentralParkVacationSuites,as more particularly described onExhibitA attached hereto and made a part hereof by reference. Capitalized terms used in this Unit Power of Attorney not otherwise defined shall have themeaning set forth in the Declaration of Covenants,Conditions and Restrictions andVacation Ownership Instrument for CentralPark Vacation Suites, as amended (the “Timeshare Declaration") and the Declaration of Condominium for The 101 W 57 Condominium,as amended (the“Condominium Declaration") and together with the Timeshare Declaration,the ("Declarations"). The undersigned,herein after referred to as“Grantor”,does hereby: Accept and ratifythe provisions of theTimeshare Declaration,theBylawsof CentralParkOwnersAssociation, Inc.("Timeshare Association"), the Rules and Regulations of the Timeshare Association, the Condominium Declaration,the Bylaws of The 101 W 57 Condominium Association ("Condominium Association"),and the Rules and Regulations ofthe Condominium Association and agrees to complywith allthe terms and provisions thereof,as the same maybe amendedfrom timeto time. Furthermore, Grantor confirms the appointment of the president and the vice president of the Timeshare Association or other person designated by the Board, as stated in Section 10.3 of the Timeshare Declaration, as its attorney-in-fact pursuant toanirrevocablepowerofattorney,coupledwithaninterest,togetherwithanirrevocableproxy wit, Grantor does hereby irrevocably nominate,constitute,and appoint the such Designated Representative true and lawfulattorney-in-factfor the Grantor,coupledwith aninterest,withpower ofsubstitution,inhis,her,itsor theirown names,on behalf of all members of the Timeshare Association). The grant and confirmation pursuant to this Power of Attorney are not intended to be separate from,but merely confirmatory of,the grant pursuant to the Timeshare Declaration,except that ifthe grant of such powerofattorneyisdeemedunderlawineffective orinanywayless inclusive pursuant to the terms of the Timeshare Declaration than bya separate grant in this Power ofAttorney,then the broadest grant of authority pursuant to the power of attorney shall be the one deemed to be intended and to be effective.This designation andgrantshallrunwiththe landand bind all successors and assigns andshall remaineffectiveby and against Grantorfor so long as Grantor is the owner of an interest pursuant to theDeedrecorded herewith and thisPower of Attorney and until a successor or assign takes title to such interest, with the requirement that any such successor or assign shall be deemed tohave given the same designation and grant of power of attorney tothe same attorney-in-fact;such conveyance torequire therecordationofaPower ofAttorney against such subsequent owner,whetherthe conveyanceis by deed or operation of law,，and if not actually done,shall be deemed to havebeen done upon the transfer of title. Furthermore, the Grantor gives the attorney-in-fact power to execute any documents or forms required by the described above. Grantor waives any interest in the Condominium Unit5 known as The 101 W 57 Condominium and their undivided percentage interest inthe CommonElements of the Condominium,other than the undivided tenancy-in- common interest specifically conveyed hereby.
